stops.text: 13 HOW TO WIN MY HEART · A Walk from the temple around the harbor — “with every pulsing beat after walking alone”
13 HOW TO WIN MY HEART · B The corner cafe table — “I want you to notice me in a corner cafe”
13 HOW TO WIN MY HEART · C Distances, younger selves, praying elders — “with the distances we couldn't avoid”
13 HOW TO WIN MY HEART · D Victory-less seasons (inner montage) — “I've journeyed beyond any place you can conceivably
13 HOW TO WIN MY HEART · E Harvesting the poppies — “harvest a wizardry more brilliant”
13 HOW TO WIN MY HEART · F From a distant window — “Yet from a distant window, beautiful and calm”
13 HOW TO WIN MY HEART · G Stands and walks the harbor — “all the fatigue of wandering alone in thought”
